title: Influence of matrix cementation and soft rock blocks on the mechanical behavior of soil-rock mixture: insights from triaxial experiments and interpretable machine learning
summary: An interpretable ML model fitted to controlled triaxial experiments decodes soil-rock stress-strain behavior and quantifies factor contributions. Findings concern the tested mixtures and conditions; external geotechnical generalization is not established.
ai_technology: MLP and autoencoder analysis of triaxial soil-rock mixture experiments
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: An interpretable ML model fitted to controlled triaxial experiments decodes soil-rock stress-strain behavior and quantifies factor contributions. Findings concern the tested mixtures and conditions; external geotechnical generalization is not established.
evidence.unknown: Results are limited to the reported models, cohorts, datasets or experiments; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
evidence.ai_role: An MLP and autoencoder model triaxial soil-rock mixture measurements; SHAP estimates the influence of cementation and rock-block factors.
